description: This file contains the definition of an abstract class for iterating over cells in a spreadsheet worksheet within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages iteration state, configuration for handling non-existent cells, and provides methods to adjust iteration behavior.

classes.name: CellIterator
classes.description: An abstract iterator class for traversing cells within a worksheet in PHPSpreadsheet. It manages iteration configurations such as whether to only iterate over existing cells and how to handle non-existent cells.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up references to worksheet and cell collection.
